Description
The Koi Fish has been an iconic symbol in various cultures for centuries, from China and Japan to the Middle East! The Koi, or carp fish, is viewed as a powerful symbol of luck, strength, and perseverance. This 1 oz pure gold bar is housed in a colorful CertiPAMP card accompanied by a matching gift sleeve. Limited mintage of only 7,000 bars.
Each gold bar is packaged in an assay card, which certifies the bar’s weight and gold content. The anti-tamper case ensures the bar’s integrity and offers peace of mind for both investors and collectors. The assay card also features a unique serial number, adding another layer of security to your investment.
Key Features of the 2025 1 oz PAMP Suisse Good Luck Koi Fish Gold Bar .9999 Fine (in Assay)
Series Theme
: The Koi Fish has been an iconic symbol in various cultures for centuries, from China and Japan to the Middle East! The Koi, or carp fsh, is viewed as a powerful symbol of luck, strength, and perseverance
Design Excellence
: The reverse of this gold bar features the intricately detailed image of two Koi Fish swimming in harmony, symbolizing good luck and prosperity. The obverse displays the PAMP Suisse logo, its weight, purity, and a unique serial number, ensuring its authenticity and quality.
Gold Purity and Weight
: This bar is made of 999.9 pure gold and weighs 1 oz, making it both a valuable and manageable investment.
Dimensions and Thickness
: The bar measures 41 x 24 mm with a thickness of 1.66 mm, combining elegance with durability.
Packaging
: Each bar is presented in a brilliant red CertiPAMP™ assay card along with an accompanying envelope, making it not only a valuable collector’s item but also an ideal gift for the  New Year.

It is an ideal choice for collectors, investors, and those who appreciate the deep symbolism.
